authority: Operational execution mode only. Live main, exact-SHA evidence, CURRENT_PROGRAM_STATUS, Developer Manual, ADRs and owning wave governance remain authoritative.
notes: Copilot Free does not provide cloud agent background sessions.
Copilot CLI is available on all Copilot plans and GitHub Actions can authenticate it with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN using copilot-requests: write.
Free plan task concurrency is capped by Aurora at 2; the scheduler fills those slots only from the maximum safe READY frontier.
READY selection prioritizes explicit dispatch priority and then the longest remaining DAG path, while deferring tasks that declare the same shared write surface.
Blocked nodes may perform only read-only readiness work; they never materialize gated runtime.
A task already running when this standard is activated keeps its original accepted base/contract and is not invalidated retroactively.
The AI worker receives read-only repository permission. A separate deterministic publisher job applies the generated patch to an isolated branch and opens a PR.
Changing this mode to PRO_PLUS_CLOUD_AGENT later must go through normal PR/exact-head gates.
